notes: Native WebGPU/TSL-only sample with an explicit public-WebGPU optical fallback; no WebGL path.
All visible controls are a second Three.js scene using a JavaScript-generated RGBA bitmap font atlas.
The JS/TSL sample owns the directional wave spectrum, displacement, normals, roughness, foam, sky and camera composition.
The native path consumes only standard Three.js color, depth, world-normal/roughness and F0/reflection-mask guides.
Native code is limited to reusable scene registration, ray-tested directional visibility/AO and PBR reflection features; it does not embed this sample's shaders.
All water displacement, optical transport, Fresnel, caustics, Moon glint, foam, atmosphere and artistic composition remain JavaScript/TSL source content.
The optional native path uses only evaluateRayLighting and evaluateRayReflections generic APIs.
Press X to compare generic native visibility/reflections against the public WebGPU path; both retain the same JS/TSL ocean optics.
No downloaded models, images, textures, fonts, style sheets or HTML UI are used.
